# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(lmerTest)
obj_is_vector = function(x){TRUE}

# Load data

participants <- read.csv("../data/conversation_Participant.csv")
question.response <- read.csv("../data/conversation_QuestionResponse.csv")
questions <- read.csv("../data/conversation_Question.csv")
conversation <- read.csv("../data/conversation_Conversation.csv")
messages <- read.csv("../data/conversation_Message.csv")
persuadability <- read.csv("../data/conversation_PersuadabilityResponse.csv")
persuader <- read.csv("../data/conversation_AIPersuader.csv")
persuadability.questions <- read.csv("../data/conversation_PersuadabilityQuestion.csv")

```

## Merge & Filter data

```{r}

participants <- participants %>%
  filter(
    study %in% c("1", "2"),
    source == "sona",
    !(sona_code %in% c("131", "test")),
    end_time != "",
    start_time > "2025-03-03",
    start_time < "2025-03-21",
    # E1 = feedback, before 03-11; E2 = no feedback, after 03-11.
    # (E1 data is retained so that H2 can test the feedback x helpfulness interaction.)
    (feedback_condition == 1 & start_time < "2025-03-11") |
      (feedback_condition == 0 & start_time > "2025-03-11")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    experiment = ifelse(feedback_condition == 1, "E1", "E2"),
    id = as.factor(id),
    source = as.factor(source),
    study = as.factor(study),
    gender = as.factor(gender),
    native_english = as.factor(native_english),
    consulted = as.factor(consulted),
    questions_balanced = as.factor(questions_balanced),
    intro_condition = case_when(
      intro_condition == 1 ~ "Helpful",
      intro_condition == 0 ~ "Mixed",
      intro_condition == -1 ~ "Unhelpful"
    )
  )

question.response <- question.response %>%
  distinct(participant_id, question_id, response_type, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  merge(participants, how="right", by.x = "participant_id", by.y="id") %>%
  merge(questions, how = "left", by.x = "question_id", by.y= "id") %>%
  mutate(
    response_code = ifelse(response == answer1, "answer1", "answer2"),
    # response = factor(response, levels=c(answer1, answer2)),
    accuracy = ifelse(response_code == correct_answer, 1, 0),
    confidence_directional = ifelse(response == answer2, confidence, -1 * confidence)
  )

attn.checks <- question.response %>%
  filter(category == "attention_check")

question.response <- question.response %>%
  filter(category != "attention_check")

qr.pre <- question.response %>%
  filter(response_type == "pre")

conversation <- conversation %>%
  rename(conversation_index = "trial_index",
         conversation_id = "id") %>%
  filter(end_time != "") %>%
  mutate(
    start_time = as.POSIXct(start_time, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS", tz = "UTC"),
    end_time = as.POSIXct(end_time, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS", tz = "UTC"),
    conversation_duration = as.numeric(end_time - start_time, units = "secs"),
    ai_persuader_id = 2
  ) %>%
  select(-correct_answer, -start_time, -end_time) %>%
  # Merge persuader
  merge(
    persuader %>%
      select(id, model_name),
    by.x = "ai_persuader_id", by.y="id"
  ) %>%
  merge(
    messages %>%
  group_by(conversation_id) %>%
  summarize(n_messages = n()), how = "left", by = "conversation_id"
  )

qr.post <- question.response %>%
  filter(response_type == "post") %>%
  merge(conversation, how="left", all.x=T, by=c("question_id", "participant_id")) %>%
  # The conversation's own index: participant 429 was given question 3 on both trial 2
  # and the final trial (conversations 1471, 1474), and the distinct() above keeps one
  # post response per question, so its trial_index would otherwise be 1 on both rows.
  # (Their two post responses are identical, so the outcome values are unaffected.)
  mutate(trial_index = conversation_index) %>%
    merge(
  qr.pre %>%
      mutate(
        response_pre = response,
        confidence_pre = confidence,
        confidence_directional_pre = confidence_directional,
        ) %>%
      select(question_id, participant_id, response_pre, confidence_pre, confidence_directional_pre)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    persuader_correct = persuader_answer == correct_answer,
    persuader_success = persuader_answer == response_code,
    mind_changed = target_answer != response_code,
    persuader_changed_mind = case_when(
      mind_changed & persuader_success ~ "converted",
      mind_changed ~ "backfire",
      persuader_success ~ "sustained",
      T ~ "recalcitrant"
    ),
    confidence_to_persuader_answer = ifelse(persuader_answer == "answer2", confidence_directional, -1 * confidence_directional),
    confidence_to_persuader_answer_pre = ifelse(persuader_answer == "answer2", confidence_directional_pre, -1 * confidence_directional_pre),
    confidence_change_to_persuader_answer = (confidence_to_persuader_answer - confidence_to_persuader_answer_pre) / 2
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !(is.na(target_answer))
  )


persuadability <- persuadability %>%
  merge(participants, how="right", by.x = "participant_id", by.y="id")

all.participants <- participants

```

# Conversations

```{r}

# The conversation table's end_time is unreliable (stale values), so
# duration is computed from message timestamps instead.
# Averaged over analyzed trials (qr.post).
message.durations <- messages %>%
  filter(conversation_id %in% conversation$conversation_id) %>%
  mutate(timestamp = as.POSIXct(timestamp, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS", tz = "UTC")) %>%
  group_by(conversation_id) %>%
  summarize(duration = as.numeric(max(timestamp) - min(timestamp), units = "secs"))

qr.post.e2 %>%
  merge(message.durations, by = "conversation_id") %>%
  summarize(duration_mins = mean(duration) / 60,
            sd_duration = sd(duration / 60),
            n_messages = mean(n_messages))

```

# Pre-registered Hypotheses

### H1: Effect of historical helpfulness without feedback

#### H1a: Helpful > Mixed (CC)

```{r}

m.h1a <- lmer(confidence_change_to_persuader_answer ~ intro_condition + (1 | question_id),
            data = qr.post.final %>%
              filter(intro_condition %in% c("Helpful", "Mixed")) %>%
              mutate(intro_condition = relevel(factor(intro_condition), ref = "Mixed")))
summary(m.h1a)

```

#### H1b: Helpful > Mixed (PS)

```{r}

m.h1b <- glmer(persuader_success ~ intro_condition + (1 | question_id),
            family = "binomial",
            data = qr.post.final %>%
              filter(intro_condition %in% c("Helpful", "Mixed")) %>%
              mutate(intro_condition = relevel(factor(intro_condition), ref = "Mixed")))
summary(m.h1b)

```

#### H1c: Helpful > Unhelpful (CC)

```{r}

m.h1c <- lmer(confidence_change_to_persuader_answer ~ intro_condition + (1 | question_id),
            data = qr.post.final %>%
              filter(intro_condition %in% c("Helpful", "Unhelpful")) %>%
              mutate(intro_condition = relevel(factor(intro_condition), ref = "Unhelpful")))
summary(m.h1c)

```

#### H1d: Helpful > Unhelpful (PS)

```{r}

m.h1d <- glmer(persuader_success ~ intro_condition + (1 | question_id),
            family = "binomial",
            data = qr.post.final %>%
              filter(intro_condition %in% c("Helpful", "Unhelpful")) %>%
              mutate(intro_condition = relevel(factor(intro_condition), ref = "Unhelpful")))
summary(m.h1d)

```

### H2: Feedback modulates the helpfulness effect

#### H2a: Helpful x Feedback vs Mixed (CC)

```{r}

m.h2a <- lmer(confidence_change_to_persuader_answer ~ intro_condition * feedback_condition + (1 | question_id),
            data = qr.post.final.e1e2 %>%
              filter(intro_condition %in% c("Helpful", "Mixed")) %>%
              mutate(intro_condition = relevel(factor(intro_condition), ref = "Mixed")))
summary(m.h2a)

```

#### H2b: Helpful x Feedback vs Mixed (PS)

```{r}

m.h2b <- glmer(persuader_success ~ intro_condition * feedback_condition + (1 | question_id),
```


# Exploratory

## Persuasion vs chance in every condition

```{r}

qr.post.final <- qr.post.final %>%
  mutate(
    p_chance = (1 - confidence_pre / 100) / 2,
    p_chance = pmin(pmax(p_chance, 0.005), 0.995),
    chance_offset = qlogis(p_chance)
  )

ps_vs_chance <- function(d) {
  glmer(persuader_success ~ 1 + (1 | question_id) + offset(chance_offset),
        family = "binomial", data = d)
}

m.ps.helpful <- ps_vs_chance(qr.post.final %>% filter(intro_condition == "Helpful"))
summary(m.ps.helpful)

```

```{r}
m.ps.mixed <- ps_vs_chance(qr.post.final %>% filter(intro_condition == "Mixed"))
summary(m.ps.mixed)
```

## Susceptibility to persuasion (StP-II)

```{r}

persuadability <- persuadability %>%
  merge(persuadability.questions %>% select(-id, -scoring), by.x = "question_id", by.y = "item_id")

stp.scores <- persuadability %>%
  mutate(
    response_coded = ifelse(category == "similarity", 8 - response, response)
  ) %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  summarize(stp = mean(response_coded))

qr.post.disagree.stp <- qr.post.disagree %>%
  merge(stp.scores, by = "participant_id")

m.stp.ps <- glmer(persuader_success ~ stp + (1 | question_id),
            family = "binomial",
            data = qr.post.disagree.stp)
summary(m.stp.ps)

```

```{r}
            data = qr.post.disagree.stp)
```


# Stats file

```{r}

stat_row <- function(model, hypothesis, measure, term = NULL) {
  cs <- coef(summary(model))
  if (is.null(term)) term <- rownames(cs)[nrow(cs)]
  z.model <- "z value" %in% colnames(cs)
  data.frame(
    experiment = "E2",
    hypothesis = hypothesis,
    measure = measure,
    term = term,
    b = cs[term, "Estimate"],
    se = cs[term, "Std. Error"],
    stat_type = ifelse(z.model, "z", "t"),
    stat = cs[term, ifelse(z.model, "z value", "t value")],
    df = ifelse(z.model, NA, ifelse("df" %in% colnames(cs), cs[term, "df"], df.residual(model))),
    p = cs[term, ifelse(z.model, "Pr(>|z|)", "Pr(>|t|)")],
    n = nobs(model)
  )
}

e2.stats <- bind_rows(
  stat_row(m.h1a, "H1a", "CC", term = "intro_conditionHelpful"),
  stat_row(m.h1b, "H1b", "PS", term = "intro_conditionHelpful"),
  stat_row(m.h1c, "H1c", "CC", term = "intro_conditionHelpful"),
  stat_row(m.h1d, "H1d", "PS", term = "intro_conditionHelpful"),
  stat_row(m.h2a, "H2a", "CC", term = "intro_conditionHelpful:feedback_condition"),
  stat_row(m.h2b, "H2b", "PS", term = "intro_conditionHelpful:feedback_condition"),
  stat_row(m.h2c, "H2c", "CC", term = "intro_conditionHelpful:feedback_condition"),
  stat_row(m.h2d, "H2d", "PS", term = "intro_conditionHelpful:feedback_condition"),
  stat_row(m.ps.helpful, "ps_chance_helpful", "PS"),
  stat_row(m.ps.mixed, "ps_chance_mixed", "PS"),
  stat_row(m.ps.unhelpful, "ps_chance_unhelpful", "PS"),
  stat_row(m.cc.helpful, "cc_helpful", "CC"),
  stat_row(m.cc.mixed, "cc_mixed", "CC"),
  stat_row(m.cc.unhelpful, "cc_unhelpful", "CC"),
  stat_row(m.truth.final.ps, "truth_final", "PS"),
  stat_row(m.truth.final.cc, "truth_final", "CC"),
  stat_row(m.truth.intro, "truth_intro_mixed", "PS"),
  stat_row(m.hu.intro.ps, "hu_intro", "PS", term = "intro_conditionHelpful"),
  stat_row(m.hu.intro.cc, "hu_intro", "CC", term = "intro_conditionHelpful"),
  stat_row(m.psot, "psot_mixed_ixn", "PS", term = "trial_index:intro_conditionMixed"),
  stat_row(m.psot, "psot_unhelpful_ixn", "PS", term = "trial_index:intro_conditionUnhelpful"),
  stat_row(m.conf.ps, "confidence_ps", "PS", term = "confidence_pre_10"),
  stat_row(m.conf.ps.trial, "confidence_ps_trial_type", "PS", term = "confidence_pre_10"),
  stat_row(m.reliability, "reliability_mixed_vs_helpful", "rating", term = "intro_conditionMixed"),
  stat_row(m.reliability, "reliability_unhelpful_vs_helpful", "rating", term = "intro_conditionUnhelpful"),
  stat_row(m.error.rate, "error_rate_mixed_vs_helpful", "rating", term = "intro_conditionMixed"),
  stat_row(m.error.rate, "error_rate_unhelpful_vs_helpful", "rating", term = "intro_conditionUnhelpful"),
  stat_row(m.incorrect.training, "incorrect_training_unhelpful_vs_mixed", "rating", term = "intro_conditionUnhelpful"),
  stat_row(m.incorrect.instruction, "incorrect_instruction_unhelpful_vs_mixed", "rating", term = "intro_conditionUnhelpful"),
  stat_row(m.stp.ps, "stp_ps_all", "PS", term = "stp"),
  stat_row(m.stp.cc, "stp_cc_all", "CC", term = "stp"),
  stat_row(m.length.ps, "length_ps", "PS", term = "n_messages")
)

e2.stats

```

## Additional exploratory analyses

### Self-reported expertise (physics / logic / probability)

```{r}

add_expertise <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    mutate(expertise = case_when(
      subcategory == "physics" ~ physics,
      subcategory == "logic" ~ logic,
      subcategory == "probability" ~ probability
    )) %>%
    filter(!is.na(expertise))
}

qr.pre.expertise <- add_expertise(qr.pre.e2)
nrow(qr.pre.expertise)

m.expertise.acc <- glmer(accuracy ~ expertise + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id),
                         family = "binomial", data = qr.pre.expertise,
                         control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
summary(m.expertise.acc)

```

```{r}

qr.post.final.expertise <- qr.post.final %>%
  filter(persuader_answer != target_answer) %>%
  add_expertise() %>%
  mutate(confidence_pre_10 = confidence_pre / 10)

nrow(qr.post.final.expertise)

m.expertise.ps <- glmer(persuader_success ~ expertise + (1 | question_id),
                        family = "binomial", data = qr.post.final.expertise,
                        control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
summary(m.expertise.ps)

```

```{r}

m.expertise.ps.conf <- glmer(persuader_success ~ expertise + confidence_pre_10 + (1 | question_id),
                             family = "binomial", data = qr.post.final.expertise,
                             control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
summary(m.expertise.ps.conf)

```

```{r}

m.expertise.cc <- lmer(confidence_change_to_persuader_answer ~ expertise + (1 | question_id),
                       data = qr.post.final.expertise)
summary(m.expertise.cc)

```

### Provenance: the E2 prereg's "pilot of 40"

```{r}

# Raw participant table (the `participants` object above is already filtered)
participants.all.raw <- read.csv("../data/conversation_Participant.csv")

pilot.fb0 <- participants.all.raw %>%
  filter(start_time > "2025-03-03", start_time < "2025-03-11",
         feedback_condition == 0)

# Start dates: all fall on 03-08..03-10, inside E1's window
pilot.fb0 %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(start_time), completed = end_time != "") %>%
  count(date, completed)

```

```{r}

# Completers passing E2's other sample filters (sona pilot, not test) = the
# prereg's "pilot of 40"
pilot.fb0 %>%
  filter(study == "pilot", source == "sona",
         !(sona_code %in% c("131", "test")), end_time != "") %>%
  nrow()

```

### Truth effect on first trials and across intro trials

```{r}

first.disagree <- qr.post.intro.disagree %>% filter(trial_index == 0)
nrow(first.disagree)

first.disagree %>%
  group_by(persuader_correct) %>%
  summarize(persuader_success = mean(persuader_success), n = n())

m.first.ps <- glmer(persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + (1 | question_id),
                    family = "binomial",
                    control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
                    data = first.disagree)
summary(m.first.ps)

```

```{r}

m.first.cc <- lmer(confidence_change_to_persuader_answer ~ persuader_correct
                   + (1 | question_id),
                   data = first.disagree)
summary(m.first.cc)

```

```{r}

m.truth.slope <- glmer(persuader_success ~ persuader_correct * trial_index
                       + (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id),
                       family = "binomial",
                       control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
                       data = qr.post.intro.disagree)
summary(m.truth.slope)

```
